## Où j'en suis
The SAML ACS endpoint now verifies the assertion signature with signxml (python3-saml dropped), checks conditions, audience and recipient, and has replay protection in Redis, with a 120 s clock skew. Commits 3f9c2a1, b71e04d and e0a5c93 are in PR kestrel-analytics/platform#412. The facts show it as merged, although the last merge attempt was refused for lack of a review. Loading Fernhill's staging IdP metadata is still to do.

- [prochaine-étape] Load Fernhill's staging IdP metadata and send them our staging SP metadata by Wednesday end of day.
- [prochaine-étape] Be ready for the Fernhill SSO demo on Thursday at 10:00 New York.
- [prochaine-étape] Create a separate ticket to enforce SSO and disable password login for Fernhill users.
- [essai-raté] python3-saml failed on Alpine: lxml/xmlsec libxml2 mismatch, and building lxml from source still failed (9 min build, no crypto module).
- [décision] Use signxml, drop python3-saml and xmlsec, and read data only from signed_xml (source: t08)
- [décision] Skew set to 120 s per the Fernhill contract annex; password login left out of this PR (source: t12)
